tvShow.name: Colin from Accounts
tvShow.overview: Ashley and Gordon are two single(ish), complex humans who are brought together by a car accident and an injured dog. Flawed, funny people choosing each other and being brave enough to show their true self, scars and all, as they navigate life together.

episodes.name: Flash
episodes.overview: Gordon’s day goes from bad to worse when, distracted by the impulsive actions of an attractive stranger, Ashley, he accidentally hits a stray dog with his car.

episodes.name: Benedict Cumbercrapp
episodes.overview: When Ashley makes a mess in Gordon’s sock drawer, she makes an impromptu trip to Costco with Colin, Megan and her mother, to buy Gordon some new furniture.

episodes.name: Toyota Cressida
episodes.overview: Gordon accidentally sends Ashley a pic and chases her from a garage sale to a death bed to try and delete it.

episodes.name: Bubbly Sophie
episodes.overview: Ash and Gordon’s awkward sexual encounter causes them to drift apart.

episodes.name: My Amiga
episodes.overview: The Echo Park gang are impressed when Ashley takes charge during a power outage.

episodes.name: The Good Room
episodes.overview: Ashley takes Gordon to her birthday dinner at Lynelle and creepy Professor Lee’s house.

episodes.name: Bandit
episodes.overview: Ashley and Gordon’s relationship is tested when she invites her party-loving friends to Echo Park to celebrate her birthday.

episodes.name: High Needs People
episodes.overview: Ashley and Gordon must find a new home for Colin so they can go their separate ways.

episodes.name: Blessings
episodes.overview: Ash and Gordon have moved in together and are trying to get their beloved, special needs dog back from his new owners.

episodes.name: Bacon in the Drawer
episodes.overview: Gordon and Ashley have to come to terms with Yvette’s latest play for Gordon’s affections.

episodes.name: Heavy
episodes.overview: Gordon’s house is overrun by chaotic visitors, including Gordon’s brother Heavy, who makes things awkward with Ash when he indelicately sheds some light on Gordon’s past.

episodes.name: Ethical Porn
episodes.overview: Ash feels rejected after catching Gordon ‘taking care of himself’, Gordon gets an offer to buy Echo Park, and Megan introduces her new girlfriend.

episodes.name: Waterfall
episodes.overview: When Ash doesn’t turn up to dinner, Gordon goes on a quest around Sydney to find her.

episodes.name: Yass King
episodes.overview: Ash and Gordon head to Yass for a weekend at home with the Crapp family.

episodes.name: Wawam
episodes.overview: Gordon redirects his grief into making Colin a TV star, while Ash tries to make amends for her hurtful comment, and Lynelle hosts a fundraiser for WAWAM.

episodes.name: Speedy Susans
episodes.overview: Gordon and Ash’s relationship is put to the test at Megan and Rumi’s pop-up wedding.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 sees Ash and Gordon living together and on a journey to get their beloved dog, Colin back from his new owners.

episodes.name: Receptive Penile
episodes.overview: Gordon and Ashley are determined to move on from past embarrassments, but they can't seem to shake their collective baggage.

episodes.name: Clean, Honest, Open, Transparent Love
episodes.overview: Ash reunites with Colin, and Gordon invites her - along with her eager boyfriend, David - to his birthday party at Echo Park Brewery.

episodes.name: Monstera
episodes.overview: Ash and Gordon attempt to put their best behind them at dinner in a "romantic but not too romantic" restaurant, while David and Chelsea are both laser-focused on the future.

episodes.name: New Beginnings Champagne Breakfast
episodes.overview: Gordon and Ash take stock of themselves - and their romantic relationships - after the tapas dinner, and Brett attempts to renegotiate his position in Gordon's life.

episodes.name: Druggy Druggy Sex Party
episodes.overview: A game night at Ash's sharehouse takes an interesting turn, just as Gordon shows up to check in on Colin.

episodes.name: Matching Set
episodes.overview: Ash is hopeful when Gordon invites her on a weekend away - until she discovers that Brett and Chiara are joining them on the road trip.

episodes.name: Is That All There Is?
episodes.overview: Ash attends her Nan's funeral, where she reunites with her long-absent father. Gordon and Heavy help their mum move into an aged care home.
